title: BLACK PC port (Port Linux)
description: Contribuição de código aberto ao projeto black-pc (de Spark198rus): desenvolvimento do port nativo para Linux. Implementação de shims POSIX para o kernel do Xbox (xboxkrnl.exe), gerenciamento de threads e memória virtual no Linux, renderização gráfica via DXVK sobre Vulkan e áudio/entrada via SDL2, executando o jogo sem emulação de máquina e sem depender de Wine ou Proton.

en_US.title: BLACK PC port (Linux Port)
en_US.tagline: Open-Source Contribution: Native Linux Port of BLACK (Xbox)
en_US.description: Open-source contribution to the black-pc project (by Spark198rus): native Linux port implementation. Authored custom POSIX shims replicating Xbox kernel (xboxkrnl.exe) primitives, Linux thread and virtual memory management, DXVK over Vulkan rendering, and SDL2 audio/input backends to run the game natively without Wine or Proton.
highlights: Authored the native Linux port for Spark198rus's black-pc project, running natively without Wine or Proton
Custom POSIX compatibility layer implementing Xbox kernel primitives, virtual memory, and native Linux threads
Direct3D 9 graphics pipeline running via DXVK over Vulkan on native Linux at 60 FPS with modern resolutions
